title: 49 unmigrated direct-getRepository callsites in hr-service / config-service / messaging-service / farm-service tenant-export — Phase B' migration backlog
rule_violated: CLAUDE.md "getRepository() is FORBIDDEN → use getScopedRepository()". Phase B (PR-4 farm-service, PR-5 sensor + billing + auth) migrated 5 of the 6 backend services that had the violation; hr-service / config-service / messaging-service / farm-service-tenant-export carry the remaining 49 callsites. The CI lint scope (`nx affected -t lint`) does not surface these on PRs that don't touch the affected services.
notes: Surfaced during PR #159's SEC-REVIEW-003 + Tier-3 invariant landing. The new no-direct-getrepository-call.spec.ts invariant in tests/invariants/ is the architectural detector — it runs in the always-on invariants:fast shard, bypassing the affected-vs-all lint scope class. Each pre-existing callsite carries an `// eslint-disable-next-line no-restricted-syntax -- AUDIT-MEDIUM-014: ...` annotation linking back to this finding; new callsites cannot land without an annotation OR a tenantManagerRepo migration. Closure: split into per-service migration PRs following the Phase B pattern. hr-service is the heaviest (33 sites across 30 handlers) — same `queryRunner.manager.getRepository(X) → tenantManagerRepo(queryRunner.manager, X, tenantId)` substitution PR-4 used for farm-service.
narrative: - hr-service: 33 sites across ~30 handlers (aquaculture/, attendance/, hr/, performance/). Mechanical migration — every handler uses the same `queryRunner.manager.getRepository(Entity)` pattern that PR-4 / PR-5 substituted for farm/sensor/billing.
- config-service: 6 sites across 4 configuration handlers. Same mechanical pattern.

- messaging-service: 5 sites across 4 services using a `manager ? manager.getRepository(X) : this.fooRepo` conditional pattern. Migration requires careful preservation of the no-transaction fallback path; cannot be a blind text substitution.
- farm-service tenant-export: 1 site in compliance/services/tenant-export.service.ts. Cross-tenant admin path (the export job spans tenants by design); annotate-with-rationale, do NOT migrate.
- messaging channel handler: 1 site (multi-line). Mechanical migration after careful read.

Closure plan: 4 follow-up PRs scoped one per service. Each closes a portion of AUDIT-MEDIUM-014 with `Closes:` trailers naming this finding. Final closure (state RESOLVED) once every callsite is either migrated or carries a structurally-justified library-level annotation. Owner: multi-tenant-saas-expert per CLAUDE.md "Tenant-ID sourcing" section.
